etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English verbe, directly from Latin verbum (“word, verb”), reinforced by Old French verbe, from Proto-Indo-European *werdʰo-. Doublet of verve and word.

definitions.definition: (grammar) A word that indicates an action, event, or state of being.
